name: fluidigm_c1
description: Fluidigm C1 plate/full-length single-cell RNA-seq. Public records often represent individual captured cells or wells and require sample-level review before biological-sample interpretation.
notes: UniScFlow recognizes Fluidigm C1 metadata and long full-length FASTQs, downloads and organizes the data, then halts by default. After confirming whether GSMs represent cells, wells, or biological samples, rerun mapping explicitly or provide a sample map.

halt_guidance.blocker: Fluidigm C1 deposits can encode individual cells/wells as GSMs or runs and may use full-length, UMI, or custom protocols; biological-sample grouping cannot be assumed safely.
required_inputs: Cell/well-to-biological-sample map and confirmation of the C1 protocol/application
Read pairing, strandedness, and confirmation that no custom barcode/UMI parsing is required
next_steps: Determine whether each GSM/run is a cell, well, or biological sample and recover the plate/chip map.
Confirm that the library is full-length cDNA without unresolved cell-barcode or UMI processing.
If confirmed, prepare the explicit STAR-featureCounts target and verify one output column per intended cell/well; otherwise use the study-specific pipeline.

recommended_workflows.name: UniScFlow STAR-featureCounts target
recommended_workflows.role: Full-length non-UMI C1 libraries after explicit cell/well and read-layout review

halt_guidance.resume: Rerun with an explicit Fluidigm C1 STAR-featureCounts target only after confirming full-length non-UMI inputs and the cell/well map.
